Hi June, I can't set this up as a recurring job. I don't have a scheduling tool in this conversation, so I can't commit to posting a "Pod end of day" note at 17:30 every weekday. Nothing has been scheduled.

If you want it, here are two options:
- **Manual:** ask me in #strategic-pod at the end of the day and I'll post that day's new messages as the note.
- **Scheduled:** ask an admin to add a recurring job for me, or set one up on your side, and I'll format the note when it fires.
